name: Turmeric Plot Tokenization
description: Real-world-asset tokenization of turmeric cultivation plots (ERC-20) — a fast-cycle (~9-month) second vertical alongside bamboo-plot within the same commodity-agnostic agri-RWA pattern. Shares the same additionality/provenance field shape as bamboo-plot (plotId, location, areaHectares, landClass, baselineLanduse, plantingGeometry, carbonRegistryBinding, certificate hash-pinning) so a cross-commodity registry view can treat both plot types uniformly; crop-specific fields are swapped for what actually drives turmeric's value (curcumin content, harvest cycle) instead of bamboo's standing-biomass carbon story. Total token supply for a plot represents 100% fractional ownership of that plot's yield rights. Minting registers a new plot's shares against a verified land/cultivation record (gated behind maker-checker approval). Transfers double as the on-chain chain-of-custody record as physical custody of harvested rhizomes passes from grower to processor to distributor to retailer. Burning retires a plot's shares. Freeze places a compliance hold on an account.

plotId.description: Registry identifier for the specific turmeric plot/parcel — enforced unique so one plot is tokenized only once

variety.description: Turmeric variety cultivated, e.g. Alleppey Finger, Erode, Salem, Rajapuri — the bamboo-plot equivalent of 'species'

cooperativeOrGrower.description: Cultivating entity — cooperative, farmer collective, or individual grower

totalShares.description: Total token supply that represents 100% fractional ownership of this plot — a holder's fraction of the plot is their balance divided by this figure

cultivationStartDate.description: Date cultivation began on this plot (YYYY-MM-DD)

harvestCycleMonths.description: Length of this plot's cultivation-to-harvest cycle, in months. Turmeric is typically 8-10 months — the concrete evidence of the 'faster-cycle' difference from bamboo's multi-year establishment window.

curcuminContentPct.description: Curcumin content, the primary quality/export-price driver for turmeric (export-grade is typically 3-5%+). Verified at harvest via lab test — the turmeric equivalent of bamboo's species-verification premium.

certificationBody.description: Sustainable-cultivation certification authority, e.g. organic certifier, GI-tag authority

certificateUrl.description: Off-ledger link to the cultivation/sustainability/GI certificate (only its hash lives on-ledger)

certificateHash.description: SHA-256 of the certificate (pins the off-ledger document as proof of origin)

linkedCarbonCreditAssetId.description: Asset id of a carbon-credit (VCU) instrument separately minted against this plot, if a soil-carbon or other claim applies — optional; most annual-crop plots have no linked carbon instrument, unlike bamboo's standing-biomass claim

landClass.description: PRIVATE or REVENUE_NON_FOREST land only — forest land is permanently ineligible for any carbon claim. Optional; only relevant if this plot pursues a carbon claim.

baselineLanduse.description: Land use in the period before this plot was planted — DEGRADED, FALLOW, CROPLAND or BUND. Additionality evidence, only relevant if this plot pursues a carbon claim. Optional.

plantingGeometry.description: BUND, INTERCROP, or BLOCK. Optional; only relevant if this plot pursues a carbon claim.

carbonRegistryBinding.description: Which carbon registry this plot's sequestration is (or will be) credited under, if any — NONE, VERRA_VM0047, BEE_CCTS, GOLD_STANDARD. Same controlled vocabulary as bamboo-plot's field of the same name, so a cross-commodity registry view can compare both. Optional.
